title: Lead I : BSA Business System Analyst
description:
**Role description**  

*Who we are:*
At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.
**Position:** Business Systems Analyst / Business Analyst – Data  

**Experience:** 6–9 Years  

**Domain:** US Healthcare  

**Primary Skills:** Data Modeling, Data Normalization, RDBMS, SQL, Python, Tableau
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced **Business Systems Analyst (BSA)** with **6–9 years of experience**, preferably with strong exposure to the **US Healthcare domain**. The candidate should have hands\-on experience in **data modeling, database concepts, SQL, Python, and Tableau**, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective data and reporting solutions.
The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, data engineers and reporting/BI teams to understand requirements, analyze healthcare data, define data structures and support data\-driven business solutions.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Gather, understand and document business requirements from stakeholders.
* Analyze business processes and translate requirements into **data and functional specifications**.
* Design and review **conceptual, logical and physical data models**.
* Apply **data normalization and database design principles**.
* Understand relationships between different entities/tables and define appropriate keys, relationships and constraints.
* Work extensively with **RDBMS** and relational database concepts.
* Write complex **SQL queries** for data extraction, validation and analysis.
* Perform data analysis, reconciliation and validation to identify data quality issues.
* Use **Python** for data analysis, manipulation, validation and automation where required.
* Create and maintain **Tableau dashboards and reports** based on business requirements.
* Work with large healthcare datasets and understand data relationships, business rules and data flows.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Developers, QA, BI teams and business stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into technical/data requirements for development teams.
* Support UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating data and resolving discrepancies.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for data/reporting issues.
* Prepare documentation including BRDs, functional specifications, data mapping documents, process flows and data dictionaries.

  

**Skills**  

Data Modeling, Python, SQL, Tableau

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Quality Assurance Technician, Music Visual experience team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad\-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on\-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa\-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.  

  

Position Overview \-
  

* Debugging, troubleshoot and maintain automation scripts by fixing the stability issues.
* Writing test cases (not test plans) that are high quality, high value and maintainable.
* Able to reproduce product defects \& script failures to assist developers or other testers and identify, track, and accurately report defects found.

* You acquire knowledge of the features and detailed functional requirements of the work to execute your assigned tests, and find gaps in the test plan/test coverage.
* Good knowledge in language, vocabulary \& grammar \& contextual information
* Ability to deep dive on applications \& comparing features between various versions \& identifying changes made within versions

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Black Box testing
* Write test cases for the new feature, modifying and maintaining the existing test cases.
* Understand and ramp up on QA procedures, guidelines and policies for newly launched feature and apply them
* Use software tools for QA, fix up and data capture on a daily basis
* Be proactive in identify issues, deep dive, troubleshoot, communicate to stake holders and escalation of issue and providing status reports
* Be part of a highly charged work environment
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ months of non\-internship professional software development testing experience
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in API \& Mobile testing

title: Senior QA Engineer with Playwright experience
description:
Client: Our client is one of the world's largest investment funds, managing hundreds of billions of dollars. The company's business is focused on several areas: private equity, venture capital, real assets, investment solutions, and global market strategies.
  
Project overview: The project focuses on improving the stability, quality, and reliability of a web\-based portal by implementing automated testing practices and robust validation procedures. The team supports multiple product streams and aims to streamline quality assurance through intelligent automation and modern tooling.
  
Position overview: We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer with hands\-on experience in both manual and automated testing using Playwright. You will be involved in building, maintaining, and scaling automated test suites, improving test coverage across browsers and devices, collaborating with developers, and ensuring consistent quality across web products. This person will contribute to a reliable and scalable test automation approach while also leveraging AI tools to accelerate testing workflows.
  
Technology stack: Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, API testing tools, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), Git, defect tracking tools
  
* Responsibilities: Plan and implement automated UI and API tests using Playwright
* Maintain and optimize existing automated test suites across browsers and devices
* Perform manual testing where automation is not the highest\-value approach
* Collaborate with developers and QA specialists to identify test scenarios
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
* Support test management practices: test plans, regression suites, defect tracking, and reporting
* Investigate issues, analyze root causes, and document findings
* Use AI tools to accelerate test creation, identify coverage gaps, and triage failures
* Contribute to test documentation and reusable automation patterns


  
* Requirements: Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright for end\-to\-end test automation
* Ability to write and maintain reliable, maintainable test scripts across browsers and devices
* Experience with CI/CD integration of automated tests (e.g., GitHub Actions)
* Experience with API testing and ability to automate both UI and backend validation
* Comfortable working with Git and contributing to shared test repositories
* Ability to identify high\-value areas for automation vs. manual testing
* Familiarity with test management practices: test plans, regression suites, defect tracking, and reporting


  
* Nice to have: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate test creation, debugging, and code review
* Experience or strong interest in using AI to generate test cases, identify coverage gaps, or triage failures
* Mindset oriented toward reducing manual QA effort through intelligent automation and tooling

title: Senior QA Engineer - Trading
description:
Overview:
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**


With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.


Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Corporate Functions** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.


Responsibilities:
**Position Purpose:** The QA Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality and stability of the Nexus Futures trading ecosystem, including order management, execution services, broker and exchange connectivity, and post\-trade processing. The role delivers comprehensive test coverage across business initiatives and platform modernisation efforts through a combination of functional testing, automation, risk\-based quality assurance, and release validation. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the QA Engineer helps ensure reliable, resilient, and scalable trading solutions that support StoneX's futures business and clients globally.  

The team is actively investing in AI\-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls.
Testing is performed in both manual and automated fashion, but the team focuses on expanding the automated test suites. The projects you will be working on are mainly server\-side. **Technology Ecosystem:*** API Tools: Swagger, Postman, Devtools
* Back End: C\#, SQL Server, WebApi, ReqNRoll/Specflow, Gherkin, Cucumber, FIX
* Architect: Docker Kubernetes, TeamCity, BitBucket, Jira, Confluence, Octopus, Rancher, Influx, KPI Metrics, Nolio
* Cloud: DataDog, Kafka, Databricks, Redis
* **AI \& Productivity Tools:** Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT

 **Primary duties will include:*** Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Own test strategy, estimation, test planning and test execution for new features, enhancements, and production fixes.
* Identify and prioritize test cases for automation, considering both functional and non\-functional requirements and implementing the existing test automation frameworks for backend side of trade system in Specflow/ReqNRoll.
* Test end\-to\-end trading flows across, execution services, FIX gateways, exchange/broker connectivity and downstream processing.
* Analyse server and application logs, system data to isolate defects, support root\-cause analysis and provide clear evidence to Engineering.
* Analyse complex systems, spot trends, draw conclusions, and produce specifications and decisions.
* Perform API, service, database and message\-level testing using appropriate tools and SQL queries.
* Assess release risk, define test exit criteria and provide clear QA recommendations for UAT, production deployment and operational readiness.
* Managing the release deployment in various environments with cooperation with different teams.
* Contribute actively to requirements refinement, Three Amigos discussions, sprint planning, defect triage, demonstrations and retrospectives.
* Document test plans, test cases, and test results to facilitate communication and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort.

  


Qualifications:
**To Land this role you will need:*** Strong professional experience testing complex trading, financial, transactional or other high\-integrity backend systems.
* Hands\-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing in an Agile delivery environment.
* Confident API and backend\-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data.
* Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test\-evidence preparation.
* Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows.
* Practical automation experience using C\# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework.
* Experience with Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling.
* Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk\-based test coverage and traceable evidence.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign\-off, UAT support and production release.

**What will make you stand out:*** Exchange\-traded derivatives, particularly US Futures.
* Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems.
* FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution\-report\-based order lifecycles.
* High\-throughput or low\-latency distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies.
* Operational resilience, failover, disaster recovery and controlled production releases.
* Experience with tools or technologies such as Postman, Swagger, SQL Server, Kafka, Kubernetes, Rancher, TeamCity, Jenkins, Octopus, Jira and Confluence.
* Experience evaluating and adopting emerging QA technologies, including AI\-assisted test generation, intelligent test selection, automated defect analysis, synthetic test data generation, and quality analytics.
* Keen interest in understanding the distributed architecture

 **Ways of working*** Builds effective relationships across Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA and Operations.
* Challenges requirements constructively and raises delivery or quality risks early with supporting evidence.
* Takes ownership of test outcomes while remaining collaborative and pragmatic.
* Balances detailed functional investigation with automation and continuous improvement.
* Shares domain knowledge and supports peer review to strengthen team resilience.

 **Education / Certification Requirements:*** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ISTQB or relevant testing certification is advantageous but not essential.

**Working environment:**

* 4 days in office per week

title: QA Engineer
description:
**QA ENGINEER**
---------------

**Overview**
------------


Tintri, a DDN company, builds enterprise storage platforms that power mission\-critical virtualized environments. Our QA Engineering team is the last line of defense before every VMstore release reaches a customer, validating everything from core storage protocols and hardware resiliency to hypervisor integrations and data\-at\-rest encryption. We're looking for a QA Engineer who's equally comfortable writing automation code and getting hands\-on with real storage hardware, someone who enjoys tracing a defect back to its root cause as much as designing the test that caught it in the first place.


You'll work closely with development throughout the release cycle, not just at the end of it, helping define what "tested" actually means for a given feature before it's built, then proving it once it is. This is a role for someone who wants deep, hands\-on exposure to enterprise storage internals (NVMe, RAID, encryption, hypervisor ecosystems) while building the automation that lets the whole team move faster and with more confidence.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, automate and execute test plans and test cases for the storage platforms.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts.
* Clear understanding of defect life cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to understand requirements and define the test strategies.
* Perform root cause analysis of defects and drive issues to resolution.
* Conduct sanity, smoke, performance and stress test coverage.
* Document test execution processes and results.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong programming ability with hands\-on experience in one or more scripting languages (preferably Python).
* Good understanding of NVMe, SAS, and SATA concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in Linux troubleshooting \& debugging.
* Experience with any one of the hypervisors.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Understanding of NAS \& SMB protocols.
* Storage platform components understanding, including SSD, DIMM, RAID, IPMI, and BMC.
* Storage encryption concepts.

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------

* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
Participates in the secure design, build, and testing of software products through the use of systematic tests. Contributes to the design and build of test frameworks and utilities needed to make the automation easier. Develops, modifies, and executes software design plans, automated scripts, and programs for quality assurance. Plays an integral part in CI/CD, facilitates defining quality gates, and ensures quality at every stage in CI/CD. Works closely with product managers and development teams in giving feedback on software requirements, planning the design execution, and resolving problems. Analyzes and writes quality standards and procedures. Analyzes test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action. Provides risk assessment of product functionality.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Develops tests, automation solutions, and architectural decisions for sophisticated, defined platforms, infrastructure, or products with a focus on security, scalability, and high\-performance
* May lead projects from end\-to\-end through delegation, review, and getting results holistically
* Initiates and drives solutions for closed loop corrective actions for a portfolio of products
* Demonstrates solid understanding and knowledge in multiple domains
* Writes functional clean code and unit tests with no guidance
* Maintains and enhances solutions by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Identifies immediate and larger scope problems through thorough code reviews
* Tests and reviews code to optimize scale, velocity, and reliability of deliverables
* Contributes to threat modeling of a feature
* Designs and plans quality assurance across various environments with thorough understanding of product expectations and business needs
* Conducts risk\-based evaluation of non\-feature characteristics of a product
* Provides recommendations to testing plans based on standard methodologies (e.g., shifting left) to ensure early quality implementation
* Applies in\-depth understanding of product design/implementation to advise junior team members on the wider ramifications of change across all products
* Works with development teams to define testing standard methodologies and propose new frameworks for testing different aspects of the product (e.g., performance, chaos, stability, load, and loss)
* Performs test cases and test plans for major projects, and coordinates within group for on\-time completion
* Reports issues/findings to developers, product managers, or other teams along with gaps in testing resources, root cause analysis, and viable software solutions
* Collaborates with product management and product development to communicate design bugs and identify potential solutions; integrates CI/CD methodologies into all processes
* Develops innovative solutions that tackle complex technical design flaws and advocates for the inclusion of additional innovation in future designs
* Identifies and socializes opportunities for improvements across the broader quality assurance rigor
* Reviews test plans and customer\-facing documentation
* Synthesizes key messages and communicates testing insights to stakeholders
